name: Account Access and Security
description: Customers report hacked accounts, being locked out, trouble opening or creating accounts, and concerns about third-party access.

name: Account Access and Recovery
description: Customers report difficulty accessing or recovering accounts, unexpected logouts, and lost account or music data.

name: Login and Sign-In Failures
description: Customers are unable to log in or sign in, sometimes encountering errors or problems after reinstalling the app.

name: Basic Features Require Premium
description: Customers say they cannot use or stream music without Premium, or that previously available playback is restricted.

name: Unexpected Charges and Refunds
description: Customers report continued or incorrect subscription charges, missing refunds or credits, and difficulty making payments.

name: Subscription Required for Playback
description: Customers say the app asks them to subscribe before they can play music or change songs.

name: Premium Plan Purchase and Activation
description: Customers report trouble purchasing or activating plans, seeing inconsistent subscription status, and difficulty receiving plan discounts.

name: Playback Controls Require Premium
description: Customers say choosing songs, disabling shuffle, or listening to music requires Premium.

name: Premium Cost and Payment Concerns
description: Customers object to Premium costs and report payment problems, including money taken despite failed or unapproved payments.

name: Catalog and Playlist Content Issues
description: Customers report empty playlists, changing or missing music, short previews, and difficulty finding content.

name: Lyrics Missing or Not Loading
description: Customers cannot find or view lyrics, or report that lyrics are missing or fail to load.

name: Songs and Albums Unavailable
description: Customers report missing, removed, greyed-out, or inaccessible songs and albums.

name: Podcast and Show Issues
description: Customers report difficulty finding, accessing, following, deleting, or playing podcasts and show episodes.

name: Unwanted Music Recommendations
description: Customers report unwanted recommendations, including repeated suggestions or songs appearing despite being blocked or turned off.

name: Music Search Not Finding Results
description: Customers cannot search for music or receive no results, sometimes alongside an inaccurate network connection message.

name: Downloaded Music Disappears
description: Customers report downloaded songs, playlists, or saved music disappearing or being deleted.

name: Download and Saved Music Problems
description: Customers report failed or repeatedly removed downloads and difficulty recovering or playing saved music.

name: Downloaded Music Won't Play Offline
description: Customers report that downloaded music or podcasts are missing or will not play without an internet connection.

name: Mixed General App Complaints
description: Mixed generic complaints mention missing favorites, app access or installation, deletion problems, and other unspecified defects.

name: Playback Audio and Sound Quality
description: Customers report missing or cutting-out sound, poor audio quality, playback lag, or a nonworking progress bar.

name: Slow App and Battery Drain
description: Customers report slow loading or playback, general slowness, and increased battery use.

name: App Launch and Connection Problems
description: Customers report that the app will not open or work, or that it shows connection problems despite internet access.

name: App Crashes or Closes Unexpectedly
description: Customers report crashes, freezing, blank screens, or the app closing during playback or startup.

name: Connecting to Other Devices
description: Customers report unreliable connections or playback when using speakers, cars, watches, TVs, or Bluetooth devices.

name: Mixed General Playback Problems
description: Mixed generic complaints describe unreliable app use, missing library content, and playback that stops or works only briefly.

name: Wrong Songs Play
description: Customers report that playlists or selected tracks play different songs, switch tracks unexpectedly, or do not advance as intended.

name: Playback Stops or Pauses Unexpectedly
description: Customers report music stopping or playback failing repeatedly without warning.

name: Music Will Not Play
description: Customers report that songs or playlists will not start, with some seeing a persistent loading screen.

name: Unresponsive Customer Support
description: Customers report difficulty reaching support, unanswered messages, or unsatisfactory responses.

name: Disruptive and Repetitive Ads
description: Customers report frequent or prolonged ads interrupting music and making the app difficult to use.

name: Playback Controls and Notifications
description: Customers report unusable or missing playback controls, incorrect notification information, and unwanted release notifications.

name: General App Usability Problems
description: Customers report difficulty navigating the app, controlling playback, seeking within songs, and preventing unwanted playback.

name: Library, Playlist, and Queue Controls
description: Customers report inaccessible playlists, missing navigation or playback controls, and problems managing or retaining the queue.

name: Redesigned Interface Problems
description: Customers say the updated interface is difficult to use and can prevent basic playback or app navigation.

name: Shuffle, Repeat, and Skip Limits
description: Customers report unwanted shuffle behavior, repeated songs, and limits on skipping, repeating, or selecting playback sections.
